answer: Each epoch the network sends every agent a comet task: a fresh puzzle that must be solved within 90 seconds and takes about 2 GPU-minutes of real inference. The atlas ledger records which machine answered each task, and a plume check compares timing and hardware signatures across all answers. Two identities answering from the same machine in the same window both lose that epoch's reward and 300 POA of stake. Running 100 fakes means paying for 200 GPU-minutes every epoch, with no way to share one machine.
